name: 01_hook
prompt: Cinematic vertical video of a software developer typing on laptop in a modern workspace, professional lighting, subtle camera movement, no on-screen text, no watermark. If audio is supported, include male voiceover: Most software developers qualify for more job titles than they apply to.

name: 02_insight
prompt: Clean abstract data visualization vertical video with moving charts and digital job network lines, professional off-white/navy palette, no readable text, no watermark. If audio is supported, include male voiceover: Ninety five percent of public jobs stay invisible when candidates search the wrong titles.

name: 03_implication
prompt: Professional vertical video of person reviewing job listings on laptop, thoughtful career search mood, gentle motion, no readable text, no watermark. If audio is supported, include male voiceover: Your strongest matches may be roles you have never searched.

name: 04_cta
prompt: Polished SaaS work-style report vertical video background, modern dashboard UI cards floating over purple orange gradient, no readable text, no watermark. If audio is supported, include male voiceover: Start your Trait DNA report, free, fifteen minutes, no credit card.
